texts.text: You’re our premiere captain. Bring Loop back and help us finish The Little Bridge. Our crew made Pip together—you made the backpack! Read my story note and Remy’s model note, try your plan on the rehearsal rail, then start the show. The audience will see the version you build.
9:12 recording: Loop passes through the crew door on a cart. The recording ends at the doorway.
I saw Loop go through the crew door. Then I saw ‘CANCELED’ at the courtyard. I think our whole premiere is off.

Borrowing Loop to finish the lantern-flower shot. I need a plain wall and paper petals that stay still. If the wind keeps folding them, I’ll move the recording indoors. I’ll leave the finished animation with Loop for our premiere captain.
Lantern-flower animation captured in Media, 9:18. Loaded into Loop’s Flower tile. Story tiles and both makers’ notes are ready for the premiere captain.
The wind kept folding the petals outside. I brought Loop here and finished the flower. Everything is ready to take back. You can try the story tiles in any order.

Pip promised Grandma, ‘I’ll come to your hill, and we’ll plant this seed together before dark.’ Last night’s rain washed the footbridge away. Pip cannot swim or fly. Grandma is waiting across the river.

One little boat carries the seed safely, but it cannot carry Pip. When the boats are joined side by side, their wide tops make a bridge Pip can walk across. The seed stays dark in a boat or a hand. Its lantern-flower grows only after its roots reach the hill’s soil.

SparkFest — stories and inventions made by us
There you are! Welcome to SparkFest. It's our festival of stories and inventions. Today, visitors are coming to see the story we made together.
This is Pip, our paper traveler. That's the red backpack you helped make. Our show is called The Little Bridge.
